_about: DMRC's average train frequency during peak and off-peak hours, as on 31.08.2026, from delhimetrorail.com/train-frequency (screenshots shared by pranjal, 24 Nov 2026). Each value is [weekday, saturday, sunday] in min:sec. The page gives no peak hours, first or last trains; scripts/headways.py keeps the 2023 feed's for those. Rapid Metro and Aqua (not DMRC) are not on the page.
